name: Weaviate
description: Weaviate is an open-source vector database that stores objects together with their vector embeddings. It combines vector similarity search with keyword and hybrid search, structured filtering and multi-tenancy, and is used through REST, GraphQL and gRPC APIs with client libraries for Python, TypeScript, Go and Java.

notes.text: There is no web UI. Clients connect to REST on port 8080 and gRPC on port 50051 with the API key from AUTHENTICATION_APIKEY_ALLOWED_KEYS in /opt/weaviate_data/.env.

app_vars.name: var_api_key
app_vars.label: API Key
app_vars.help: Root API key for the admin user. Generated when left empty
